narrative.intro: Harris recorded $922M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Harris received 11 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $83.8M, and obligations are up 0.5% year over year. Harris’s multi-year record shows rising and falling obligations by fiscal year: FY21 was $376M, FY22 was $313M, FY23 was $386M, FY24 was $459M, FY25 was $918M, and FY26 is $922M. The current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is still in progress, and the page notes that figures shown are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Agencies, product detail, and expiring-contract line items are not provided on this page, so readers should treat the listed totals and year-by-year obligations as the primary available signals of Harris’s federal activity through the fiscal year to date.

sections.body: Harris showed a multi-year pattern in obligations: FY21 was $376M, FY22 was $313M, FY23 was $386M, FY24 was $459M, FY25 was $918M, and FY26 is $922M. Harris’s obligations are up 0.5% year over year, reflecting a small increase from FY25 to FY26 in the fiscal-year-to-date totals.

sections.heading: What do the award counts and sizes indicate about Harris’s FY2026 activity?
